description.value: Patio Burger & Ice Cream Co. is a beachfront restaurant that opened in 2016 at Lakawanna Park on the corner of Power Street and Lakeshore Drive in Penticton. The menu centres on 100% Canadian chuck beef burgers smash-griddled to order, hand-cut BC Kennebec potato fries made fresh throughout the day, and 13 house-made ice cream flavours. The project also involved planting over 550 flowers, plants, and trees to revitalize the surrounding park, making it a genuine community landmark along Penticton's waterfront.
